Maya: Quick shout — huge thanks to Sam for restocking the tea pantry and leaving the emergency shortbread. Saved my afternoon :heart: (reacted :sparkles:)
Sam: hahaha didn't even think anyone would notice. Found a mystery tin in the back and decided to be generous :cookie:
Priya: Legend. Also those smiley stickers on the kettle are peak office vibes. You're getting a sticker in person :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Liam: +1. The chamomile was on its last leaves. Thank you, Sam! :tea: :raised_hands:
Sam: will accept sticker bribes. Also FYI I labeled the green tea 'for calm demos' :memo:
Jenna: that label is getting added to the onboarding tour :laughing: small things, big morale boost
OpsBot: NOTE: informal kudos logged for Sam — tag: pantry-heroics
Maya: seriously though, thanks. bringing donuts tomorrow to repay the shortbread debt :doughnut:
Priya: can't wait. also remote folks, virtual sticker drop coming your way :sparkles:
Sam: aw you all, heart warmed. no need for donuts but don't say no to pastries :wink:
Liam: passing the gratitude baton to infra and support for their quick turn on the incident yesterday — deserved shoutouts too
Maya: absolutely. this thread is for Sam today but big props all around :tada:
Jenna: added a #kudos sticky to the wiki homepage for pantry heroes
Maya: end thread — sticker economy thriving :seedling:
